verdict.rationale: Notion markets AI agents that 'keep work moving 24/7' and offers webhooks for real-time event subscriptions plus a REST API/internal connections explicitly aimed at 'custom automations and workflows,' suggesting background automation is possible. However, evidence is thin marketing copy and API docs without concrete detail on scheduling, triggers, or reliability of autonomous agent runs, and no independent/hands-on corroboration exists. Missing for 10: detailed docs on agent scheduling/triggers, hands-on or community validation of autonomous background execution, and clarity on failure/reliability behavior.
